### Woodward Announces Declaration of Dividend


September 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/731819148/files/doc_news/Woodward-Announces-Declaration-of-Dividend-1937a5e36-2026.pdf)


FORT COLLINS, Colo., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Woodward, Inc. (NASDAQ:WWD) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.32 per share for the quarter, payable on December 3, 2026, for stockholders of record as of November 19, 2026.


**About Woodward, Inc.**


Woodward is the global leader in the design, manufacture, and service of energy conversion and control solutions for the aerospace and industrial equipment markets. Our purpose is to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future. Our innovative fluid, combustion, electrical, propulsion and motion control systems perform in some of the world’s harshest environments. Woodward is a global company headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado, USA. Visit our website at[www.woodward.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Ms54i_W088hZnGvVTSRkYblPIZPFOf1givqXQMgVTdVNZArzs81jJnsB8lF70nkx4YaddN0Q70aFHSWzEpDU0BGnkEcRzay5OCZh5QzMsNs=) .
